title: Tunisian Chicken Pie
description: A delicious and savory pie filled with spicy Tunisian chicken and wrapped in crispy filo pastry.
instructions: In a pan, cook the chopped onion and garlic until softened.
Add the chicken breasts and cook until browned.
Add the Tunisian harissa and cook for 1 minute.
Roll out the filo pastry and cut into squares.
Place a spoonful of the chicken mixture onto one half of each square and fold in half.
Brush the edges with pastry dough and press to seal.
Place the pies on a baking sheet and brush with pastry dough.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot garnished with chopped parsley.
